memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "My lords," he said, "please turn aside to your servant's house. You can wash your feet and spend the night and then go on your way early in the morning." "No," they answered, "we will spend the night in the square." But he insisted so strongly that they went with him and entered his house. He prepared a meal for them, baking bread without yeast, and they ate. - Gen 19:2-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Whatever Lot's compromises, here we see a genuine flicker of faithfulness. He urges the strangers not to sleep in the open square - because he knows what the streets of Sodom hold after dark. He insists they come under his roof, into his protection, and he feeds them. In a city given over to cruelty, Lot still practices the sacred duty of hospitality, still tries to shield the vulnerable.

It is a reminder that even compromised believers are not entirely lost to grace. Something of God remained in Lot. His instinct to protect strangers, to offer shelter, to show kindness - these were real, even in a corrupt setting. God's work in a person is not always extinguished by their poor choices.

Notice the echo of his uncle Abraham, who had just welcomed these same messengers with a meal and washed feet (Gen 18:4-5). Lot had learned something good in his years alongside Abraham. Godly influence leaves marks that even years of compromise cannot fully erase.

There is encouragement here for anyone who feels their faith has grown weak or their witness has been compromised. God can still work through your flickers of faithfulness. And there is a call, too: like Lot, use whatever influence you have to protect the vulnerable and show kindness. "Let us not become weary in doing good" (Gal 6:9), however dark the place we find ourselves.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Even in hard circumstances, are there "flickers of faithfulness" God is keeping alive in you?
- How can you protect the vulnerable where you are?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, thank You that You keep flickers of faithfulness alive even in weak and compromised hearts. Fan them into flame in me. Help me protect the vulnerable and do good wherever You have placed me.
Amen.
